rules.feature: File tree, workspace mount and composer
checks: Existing/new/unknown composer layouts, missing and ambiguous anchors, navigation and disposal.
Identity match without forced refresh; expired versus unavailable credentials; active-turn refusal and late replies.

Manual Verify returns verified login status independently of remote quota availability, then schedules the existing background quota queue. Verify and usage reuse observe_managed credentials without duplicate frontend Verify; quota failure does not fail successful login checks. Cached values, one-flight and owner/late-result protections remain. No quota-triggered backend replacement or extra retry counter.

rules.feature: Native model picker and API catalogs
checks: API saved model subset and default; native model/effort selection; official catalog restore; missing or ambiguous capability.
Light/dark native theme, background activation/deactivation and unchanged controls/media.
Current/stale/legacy/partial report metadata; late status after close; fixed retry admission and keyboard navigation.

rules.feature: Bridge, module loading and host runtime
checks: Trusted module discovery and bridge fields; missing/ambiguous contracts; cancellation and resource release.

rules.feature: Native local tools, permissions and protocol
checks: Local tool and approval protocol; activity/ownership checks; no request replay after unknown outcomes.

rules.feature: Official executable, launch and package identity
checks: Trusted package identity, native launch ownership, old/new/unknown versions and uninstall cleanup.

rules.feature: Launch-owned account transport and native backend startup
checks: Enabled cold launch versus disabled/not-installed launch; shared official backend spawn contract and native proxy/TLS transport.
Root/subagent ownership, mismatched identity, missing lineage, active request and cancelled/failed startup; no alternate-account fallback.
Existing plugin disable/re-enable behavior and session settings remain unchanged.

Native packaged cold launch preserves package identity through its registered execution alias and honors CODEX_CLI_PATH before startup config and actor creation; disabled plugin uses unchanged shell activation.

Native stdio wrapper preserves CLI arguments, startup config, JSONL, tools and permissions; control endpoint and thread lineage preserve owner, active-request and disable/re-enable behavior. Legacy inspector path remains supported.

Native cold startup, initial official request, first account switch, backend exit, network reconnect and core hot handoff require separate observation. Static token matching does not certify runtime behavior.

rules.feature: Responses history, tool pairing and provider-scoped opaque context
checks: Official to API to official history, provider-scoped opaque state, original archive preservation and bounded readable handoff.
Duplicate/missing call_id, incomplete compaction, cancelled/unknown outcome and compressed/oversized body refusals.
HTTP/SSE completion and errors; real provider tools and multi-turn behavior require separate explicit acceptance.

rules.feature: Native composer quota subscriptions and dismissible usage banners
checks: Exhausted primary with usable child/API: native send subscription reflects selected identity; permissions/auth remain owned by host.
Usage-card close across native card layouts; per-owner/thread/account/model/reset identity, native close reuse and reset/disposal restoration.
Missing/ambiguous native quota roles and unrelated image/media/paywall cards remain protected.

rules.feature: Composer account control continuity and native RPC observation
checks: Send-to-thinking transition, composer/control replacement, readable busy state and first-switch preparation hint.
Stable account identity across ordering/navigation, late RPC/closed panel cleanup and activity admission.

rules.feature: Quota-exhaustion continuation including API model and effort binding
checks: Official to API and API to next account in saved order; API balance remains unverified and is not read via official quota.
Exact model/effort inheritance or saved default/medium, native settings confirmation before dispatch.
Duplicate terminal events, cancelled task, transient throttling/network/permission errors and active turn do not trigger duplicate continuation.

rules.feature: Shared native settings and secondary navigation background contracts
checks: Settings shared shell/groups including display:contents wrappers, secondary pages and inline header pseudo backgrounds.
Three background attributes, light/dark, disable restoration; protect dialogs/menus/media/conversation masks and native control geometry.
